_comment: Example of the SECURITY-OWNED managed policy pushed to all developer machines (macOS/Linux managed settings path or MDM). Developers cannot override these locally. Contrast with the repo's .claude/settings.json (project hooks).
_notes: Prod-affecting deploys go through CI, never a developer's Claude session.
IAM mutation from sessions is denied; IAM changes ship as reviewed CDK diffs.
Pair with OS-level sandboxing for filesystem/network isolation.
